source: Appendix B-1 URAR Implementation Guide v1.4.pdf, each chapter's own display sentences

displays.text: The Summary section always displays.
The Subject Property section always displays.
The Site section always displays in the report; however, there are multiple data points from the Subject Property section that determine conditionality, such as: •.
The Disaster Mitigation section displays when DisasterMitigationFeatureType (UID: 3700.0002, FID: 5.000) is a value other than ‘None’.
The Energy Efficient and Green Features section displays when one or more of the three energy efficient or green features is “true”.
The Sketch section always displays.
The Dwelling Exterior section displays when ImprovementType (UID: 0300.0009, FID: Not on report) = “Dwelling”.

repeats.text: The section repeats for each dwelling on the property.
This section repeats for each manufactured home on the property that is either a dwelling or an ADU.
The Manufactured Home section repeats for each manufactured home on the property that is either a dwelling or an ADU.

displays.text: The Unit Interior section always displays.
The Functional Obsolescence section always displays in the report.
The Outbuilding section displays when ImprovementType (UID: 0300.0009, FID: Not on report) = “Outbuilding”.
The Vehicle Storage section always displays.
The Subject Property Amenities section always displays in the report.
The Overall Quality and Condition section always displays.
The Highest and Best Use section always displays with the static text, “Is the present use of the subject property …”, followed by the required fields.
The Market section always displays.
The Project Information section displays when the property is in a project (condominium, cooperative, or condop) or in a PUD.
The Subject Listing Information section with the italicized text, “Current and/or relevant listings of the subject property (minimum 1 year lookback)” always displays.
The Sales Contract section displays when an active sales contract exists.
The Sales Contract section displays when SalesContractExistsIndicator (UID: 0600.0016, FID: 20.000) = “true”.
The Prior Sale and Transfer History section always displays in the report.
Sales Comparison Approach displays when SalesComparisonApproachIndicator (UID: 1000.0032, FID: Not on report) = "true".
The Rental Information section displays when RentScheduleIndicator (UID: 1000.0031, FID: Not on report) = "true".
The section displays when IncomeApproachIndicator (UID: 1000.0030, FID: Not on report) = "true".
The Cost Approach section displays when CostApproachIndicator (UID: 1000.0027, FID: Not on report) = “true”.
The Reconciliation section always displays.
The Revision History section displays only if the information is provided.
